$comment: Night Owl. Source: https://github.com/sdras/night-owl-vscode-theme. Licence: MIT. pink = purple (no pink); muted #829ab0 derived (comment grey is 3.9:1); danger text #ff5874. The light block is Night Owl Light (https://github.com/sdras/night-owl-vscode-theme themes/Night Owl-Light-color-theme.json): canvas editor.background, inset sideBar.background, surface #ffffff, selection list.hoverBackground, border editorWidget.border, text foreground, disabled input.placeholderForeground, accent blue #4876d6 (strings), purple #994cc3, pink ansiMagenta #d6438a, cyan ansiCyan, teal #0c969b; no orange, so warning/orange = editorWarning #daaa01; muted darkened #5f7e97 to #597790, link/info/accent_solid darkened #4876d6 to #4370d0, success darkened ansiGreen to #00845e, warning darkened to #996b00, danger darkened ansiRed to #d73535 for text.
name: Night Owl
